Today's TL;DRRegimeMIXED
Markets are pulled between a soft July jobs report fueling rate-cut expectations and risk-on assets, and escalating geopolitical tensions, Fed independence threats, and commodity supply shocks. Equities rallied on AI trade revival and weak payrolls, while bonds saw rate-cut pricing and commodities surged on supply constraints. FX markets are volatile due to US intervention and yen weakness. Overall a mixed regime with conflicting signals.

AI semiconductor supply chain tightnessAI半导体供应链紧张
×10 · 38 steps
Strong demand for AI training and inference is driving expansion of SuperPod clusters and server deployments, leading to supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging, substrates, CCL, and optical interconnects, with component suppliers enjoying pricing power and technology upgrades. SuperPods scale from 384 to 8196 cards, with 200-300 units already deployed. AMD reports GW-scale agreements and tightness on N3 and CoWoS through 2027. CCL technology migration accelerates from 2H26 with M9 grade shipments.

GlobalFoundries raised its CID segment growth to 50-60% driven by AI-related silicon photonics. Merlin Properties raised capital for Data Centre pipeline. BofA projects a 57% unit CAGR for AI optical connectivity. LightCounting forecasts top five US cloud providers to expand at +29% CAGR through 2030.

Transmission4 steps
Hyperscaler AI capex funds data center construction, as seen with Merlin Properties raising capital for its Data Centre pipeline.超大规模AI资本开支为数据中心建设提供资金，例如Merlin Properties为其数据中心管线筹集资金。→New data centers drive demand for colocation services, exemplified by LG Uplus's roughly 29% AIDC growth on higher colocation revenue.新数据中心推动了对托管服务的需求，例如LG Uplus因托管收入增加而实现约29%的AIDC增长。→Colocation demand in turn fuels semiconductor foundry production, particularly for silicon photonics at GlobalFoundries (CID segment growth raised to 50-60%) and Tower.托管需求进而推动半导体代工厂生产，尤其是GlobalFoundries（CID部门增长上调至50-60%）和Tower的硅光子学产品。→Silicon photonics growth then expands the optical components market, with BofA projecting a 57% unit CAGR for AI optical connectivity and LightCounting forecasting top five US cloud providers to grow at a plus 29% CAGR through 2030.硅光子学的增长进而扩大了光学组件市场，BofA预测AI光学连接的单位CAGR为57%，LightCounting预计前五大美国云提供商到2030年将以+29%的CAGR增长。

China consumer K-shape weakness中国消费K型疲软
×7 · 25 steps
Chinese consumer demand is sharply K-shaped — Nomura revises Q3 GDP growth forecast down to 4.3% from 4.5% as high-frequency data shows housing contract sales worsening to -18.3% y/y in July and passenger car retail sales contracting 18.0% y/y. Beijing relies on existing budget with potential supplementary funding of RMB200-300bn but not large-scale new stimulus; PBoC unlikely to cut rates and any RRR cut would be 'pushing on a string'.
36 extracted · 7 firms
Consensus·7 firms·36 extracted·As of 2026-08-06
Consumer demand in China is broadly weak and diverges between premium and mass segments, with policymakers relying on existing fiscal tools rather than large stimulus.中国消费需求普遍疲软，高端与大众市场分化，政策制定者依赖现有财政工具而非大规模刺激。
Most institutions agree on broad consumer weakness and limited policy space, with debate centering on the depth of K-shape divergence and the timing of any potential rebound.多数机构认同消费普遍疲软和政策空间有限，争议主要集中在K型分化的深度以及任何潜在反弹时机。

AI compute infrastructure supply strain and pricing powerAI计算基础设施供应紧张与定价权
×10 · 39 steps
AI compute infrastructure buildout straining supply, creating pricing power and new monetization paths — AI data center demand is driving exceptional growth in optical components, with silicon photonics and advanced transceivers seeing dramatic TAM increases. GFS raised its CID segment growth to 50-60% with silicon photonics on track for a $1bn run rate by 2028. BofA projects a 57% unit CAGR for AI optical connectivity and models Tower Semiconductor at $4bn revenue in 2028. LightCounting revised datacom outlook upward ~15%, with 1.6T market increased ~35% and NPO/CPO TAM expected to reach $18bn+ by end of decade.

China selective AI+ stimulus with limited broad easing中国选择性AI+刺激与有限宽松
×4 · 16 steps
The late-July Politburo signaled policy continuity with 'more proactive fiscal' and 'moderately accommodative monetary' stance, but priorities remain AI+, advanced manufacturing, basic research, and Six Networks rather than broad consumer transfers. Goldman sizes H2 funding capacity at more than RMB8tn (vs RMB5.4tn H1), backed by RMB6.8tn unused new government bond quota (57% of RMB11.9tn full-year), RMB800bn new policy-based financial instrument (up from RMB500bn in 2025), and >RMB400bn yoy increase in central transfers; RMB1.8tn unused government bond quota. JPMorgan expects Politburo to prioritize AI infrastructure, high-tech manufacturing, energy security and broader self-reliance. Both flag a scale cap: Goldman keeps baseline of no policy rate/RRR cuts through 2026, Nomura cautions 'the scale of such measures might be limited.' Anti-involution has run nine consecutive months: nominal IP grew 7.2% YoY while manufacturing FAI fell 1.2% YoY (FAI-IP gap -8.4% in June from -6.9% in May), industrial mid-to-long term loan growth moderated to 5.9% YoY from 6.8%.

The July 28-29 FOMC has become a high-event-risk meeting. Japan's MOF and the US Treasury conducted coordinated yen-buying intervention for the first time since 1998, driving a rebound in the yen from its weakest level since 1986. The intervention occurred on 30 July. The yen strengthened post-intervention, but the impact may be limited with a low likelihood of major appreciation below 150.

    On 9th June 2026 GSK announced its intention to acquire US biotech Nuvalent for $11 billion, equivalent to a 40% premium to Nuvalent's last closing share price; Nuvalent is focused on NSCLC (ca. 85% of all lung tumors) and its two drugs zidesamtinib and neladalkib have been submitted to FDA with peak sales consensus of $1bn and $3bn respectively; ROS1 and ALK mutations account for 1-3% and 2-5% of NSCLC cases.
    b3ad282b44ee·《GSK (O): Why is the new CEO's transformation underappreciated?》·2026-08-03

    Conclusion交易提升治疗时长与预期
    56 %；28 %；41 %；85 %；61 %；37 %；33 GBP bn
    Bernstein likes the Nuvalent transaction for four reasons: (1) increasing Duration of Therapy (DOT) is underappreciated by consensus, with global treatment naive (1L) sales of neladalkib and zidesamtinib respectively accounting for 56% and 28% of Nuvalent's group sales CAGR (27-40e) of 41%; (2) Lower penetration of ALK and ROS1 inhibitors (37% and 61% per Exhibit 21) vs the more mature EGFR category (85%); (3) GSK has a strong understanding of ALK and EGFR inhibitors in NSCLC, with senior employees including CEO Luke Miels (ex-AstraZeneca oncology) and SVP of Global Product Strategy Nina Mojas (ex-Roche oncology), plus head of R&D Dr Tony Wood (involved in Lorbrena design at Pfizer); (4) GSK has a much stronger ex-US footprint than Nuvalent (founded 2017), with just under half of 2025 global sales of £33bn derived outside the US.
    b3ad282b44ee·《GSK (O): Why is the new CEO's transformation underappreciated?》·2026-08-03

AI capex spreads credit taleAI资本支出波及信用债利差
×3 · 11 steps
AI capex is reconnecting hyperscaler credit and equity markets while placing pressure on new-issue concessions: GS shows hyperscaler-non-hyperscaler 30y credit spread has widened up to ~80bp while the hyperscaler minus S&P 500 NTM FCF yield gap has eroded to ~-4.5% on the back of higher long-end spread volatility, with debt-funded capex structurally raising the cost of credit and credit outcomes hinging on whether free cash flow improves from capex declines or rising monetization. Goldman's credit team reports USD IG YTD gross issuance approaching $1.5tn (+31% YoY) and USD HY $195bn (+10% YoY), with USD IG new-issue concessions 'pressured during the early stages of the Middle East conflict' and AI-related deals 'priced with larger-than-typical concessions', while Bernstein shows Amazon raised its 2026 CapEx guide by ~$20B to ~$220B 'driven in part by higher memory and BOM costs' and management emphasized 'elevated investment levels will continue through 2027 and 2028'. JPM HG HPC index widened +38bp to 208bp on the same AI demand backdrop.

US Labor Market Deterioration
The July jobs report showed an unexpected payroll decline of 23,000 versus consensus expectations of +83,000, with downward revisions to prior months. ADP private payrolls added just 44,000, well below forecasts. The workforce shrank by over 1 million over the past year, participation fell to near-pandemic lows, and falling long-term unemployment reflects worker exodus rather than job gains. This broad-based weakening pressures the Fed to cut rates and raises stagflation concerns.

Escalating Middle East Supply Threats Keep Oil Risk Premium Elevated
Despite Hormuz deal talk, multiple military actions and threats to key chokepoints continue to support crude and shipping costs: Houthi attacks on Saudi forces and a tanker in the Red Sea, Iran's push to ban US/Israeli vessels from Hormuz, and the blocking of the Bab el-Mandeb strait are causing tankers to reroute Saudi Red Sea loadings via Egypt and Suez to mask disruptions.
